import React from 'react' import {Container, Row, Col} from 'react-bootstrap' function Station({station_info}) { return (
Train Name : {station_info["station_name"]} Arriving at : {station_info["timing"].substring(0, station_info["timing"].length/2)} Platform number : {station_info["platform"]} Halt : {station_info["halt"]} Delay : {station_info["delay"]} Distance : {station_info["distance"]}
) } export default Station
